function.name: check_room_availability
function.description: Check what's available for a date range, with prices and views. One tool for every "what do you have?" / "how much?" / "any king available?" / "any smoking rooms?" question. Read-only browsing: it never books anything - when the caller wants to actually book, call start_room_booking instead. Surface the results progressively (types first, details after they narrow), don't recite the whole list.

check_in.description: Check-in date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-01-20").

check_out.description: Check-out date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

guests.description: Number of guests in the room (must be >= 1; ask the caller if not specified).

smoking.description: The caller's stated smoking preference, or "no_preference" if they haven't said.

room_type.description: The room type the caller picked, or "any" to list everything.
